lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible on the flank superior to the dorsal fin insertion. The most prominent row contains four local maxima spaced approximately 50-70 pixels apart in a linear arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the spot rows, creating a defined grid-like pattern of anchor nodes on the upper flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature runs horizontally across the flank superior to the dorsal fin, characterized by a sharp luminance peak on the upper edge and a high-contrast shadow gradient on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a high density of small, circular high-luminance blobs. Distribution is highest near the anterior base with approximately 15-20 distinct nodes, becoming smaller and more uniform toward the posterior trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 18-22 small, elongated, dark silhouettes (commensal fish) is positioned trailing the posterior margin of the dorsal fin.
